precision: Original BF16 weights and activations; FP32 recurrent states. No added quantization.
limits: 100 seeded GSM8K official-test samples without thinking; first 20 repeated with thinking.
Greedy output caps are 1024 / 4096. Truncated or unparsed outputs count as incorrect.
Official labels are unchanged, including known problematic references; this is not a complete quality evaluation.
Each mode used fresh decode CUDA Graphs with overlap disabled and fixed batches of 16.
An initial audit without explicit stop tokens was discarded. A later graph-recapture allocator failure occurred after baseline scoring; remaining modes were loaded in separate processes.

candidate_decisions.cuda_topk: Rejected: three previously correct no-thinking answers hit the output cap; no serving performance claim.
candidate_decisions.tuned_triton: Not retained: throughput gain 0.1554% in one full run does not establish a useful improvement; mean TPOT slightly increased, and capped thinking accuracy lost one correct answer on net.

precision_note: Compiler and eager FP32 sigmoid differed by up to 1.1920928955078125e-7 in checked inputs. Original and experimental packing agreed exactly on those inputs. Only the sigmoid reference allows a few FP32 ULPs; expert IDs and rounded routing weights use zero-tolerance checks.
checkpoint_moe_numerical_note: Independent expert GEMMs use aligned routing and real activations collected during the final accuracy mode. The candidate_ids_equal / candidate_max_scale_error fields compare rejected CUDA top-k with aligned routing on those activations only.
